+def freeze_synthetic_v2_pinset(
+    root: Path,
+) -> tuple[Path, str, dict[str, generalized.V2ProducerInputs]]:
+    pinset, inputs = synthetic_v2_fixture()
+    draft_path, draft_sha256 = write_pinset(root, pinset)
+    parsed = generalized.load_pinset(draft_path, draft_sha256)
+    assert isinstance(parsed, generalized.V2Pinset)
+    _artifact, components = generalized._build_v2_artifacts(
+        pinset=parsed,
+        pinset_path=draft_path,
+        pinset_sha256=draft_sha256,
+        producer_inputs=inputs,
+        project_commit="0" * 40,
+        project_tree_state="clean",
+    )
+    for producer, entry, component in zip(
+        pinset["producer_plans"],
+        pinset["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"],
+        components,
+    ):
+        digest = generalized._artifact_sha256(component)
+        producer["component_artifact"]["sha256"] = digest
+        entry["sha256"] = digest
+    producer_hashes = [
+        generalized._canonical_json_sha256(producer)
+        for producer in pinset["producer_plans"]
+    ]
+    for entry, digest in zip(
+        pinset["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"], producer_hashes
+    ):
+        entry["producer_pin_sha256"] = digest
+    pinset["aggregate"]["producer_set_sha256"] = (
+        generalized._canonical_json_sha256(pinset["producer_plans"])
+    )
+    path, digest = write_pinset(root, pinset)
+    return path, digest, inputs

   349	def _write_bundle(
   350	    root: Path,
   351	    *,
   352	    bundle_id: str,
   353	    metric_value_j: float,
   354	    half_width_j: float,
   355	    plan_sha256: str,
   356	    block_id: str | None = None,
   357	    position: str | None = None,
   358	) -> tuple[str, str]:
   359	    bundle = root / bundle_id
   360	    bundle.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   361	    tags = [f"calibration-plan-sha256={plan_sha256}"]
   362	    if block_id is not None and position is not None:
   363	        tags.extend(
   364	            [
   365	                f"calibration-abba-block-id={block_id}",
   366	                f"calibration-abba-label={position[0]}",
   367	                (
   368	                    "calibration-abba-sequence-index="
   369	                    f"{('A1', 'B1', 'B2', 'A2').index(position) + 1}"
   370	                ),
   371	            ]
   372	        )
   373	    config = {
   374	        "run_id": bundle_id,
   375	        "run_metadata": {"tags": tags},
   376	        "hardware_target": {"telemetry_backend": "powermetrics"},
   377	    }
   378	    summary = {
   379	        "status": "succeeded",
   380	        "phase_energy_j": {"decode": metric_value_j},
   381	        "energy_anchor_shift_envelopes": {
   382	            "/phase_energy_j/decode": {
   383	                "point_j": metric_value_j,
   384	                "lower_j": metric_value_j - half_width_j,
   385	                "upper_j": metric_value_j + half_width_j,
   386	                "max_abs_delta_j": half_width_j,
   387	            }
   388	        },
   389	        "energy_bound_terms_j": {
   390	            "E_interpolation_joint_edge_bound_j": 0.0
   391	        },
   392	        "window_evidence_precheck": {
   393	            "phase": {
   394	                "decode": {
   395	                    "windows": [
   396	                        {
   397	                            "window_duration_s": 1.0,
   398	                            "observed_window_p95_sample_gap_s": 0.1,
   399	                            "observed_bracketing_max_sample_gap_s": 0.2,
   400	                            "cadence_ratio": 1.5,
   401	                            "clock_anchor_bound_s": 0.01,
   402	                            "interpolation_joint_edge_bound_j": 0.02,
   403	                        }
   404	                    ]
   405	                }
   406	            }
   407	        },
   408	    }
   409	    (bundle / "config.json").write_text(
   410	        json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8"
   411	    )
   412	    (bundle / "metadata.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
   413	    (bundle / "summary_metrics.json").write_text(
   414	        json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8"
   415	    )
   416	    return (
   417	        complete_bundle_sha256(bundle),
   418	        hashlib.sha256((bundle / "config.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
   419	    )

   422	def _install_component_fixture(
   423	    base: Path,
   424	    label: str,
   425	    component: mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   426	    *,
   427	    evidence_root: Path | None = None,
   428	) -> generalized.ComponentInputs:
   429	    root = evidence_root or (base / f"{label}-root")
   430	    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   431	    spec_path = base / f"{label}-spec.json"
   432	    spec_path.write_text(json.dumps(component.spec), encoding="utf-8")
   433	    member_by_id = {member.bundle_id: member for member in component.members}
   434	    rows = []
   435	    if component.kind == "absolute":
   436	        for index, spec_row in enumerate(component.spec_cell["members"]):
   437	            member = member_by_id[spec_row["bundle_id"]]
   438	            width = component.widths_j[index]
   439	            bundle_sha256, config_sha256 = _write_bundle(
   440	                root,
   441	                bundle_id=member.bundle_id,
   442	                metric_value_j=member.metric_value_j,
   443	                half_width_j=width,
   444	                plan_sha256=component.order_manifest["calibration_plan_sha256"],
   445	            )
   446	            rows.append(
   447	                {
   448	                    "bundle_id": member.bundle_id,
   449	                    "bundle_sha256": bundle_sha256,
   450	                    "config_sha256": config_sha256,
   451	                    "metric_value_j": member.metric_value_j,
   452	                    "anchor_shift_bound_j": width,
   453	                    "excluded": False,
   454	                    "reasons": [],
   455	                }
   456	            )
   457	    else:
   458	        for block_index, block in enumerate(component.spec_cell["blocks"]):
   459	            member_width = component.widths_j[block_index] / 2.0
   460	            for position in ("A1", "B1", "B2", "A2"):
   461	                member = member_by_id[block["members"][position]]
   462	                bundle_sha256, config_sha256 = _write_bundle(
   463	                    root,
   464	                    bundle_id=member.bundle_id,
   465	                    metric_value_j=member.metric_value_j,
   466	                    half_width_j=member_width,
   467	                    plan_sha256=(
   468	                        component.order_manifest["calibration_plan_sha256"]
   469	                    ),
   470	                    block_id=block["block_id"],
   471	                    position=position,
   472	                )
   473	                rows.append(
   474	                    {
   475	                        "bundle_id": member.bundle_id,
   476	                        "bundle_sha256": bundle_sha256,
   477	                        "config_sha256": config_sha256,
   478	                        "metric_value_j": member.metric_value_j,
   479	                        "anchor_shift_bound_j": member_width,
   480	                        "block_id": block["block_id"],
   481	                        "position": position,
   482	                        "excluded": False,
   483	                        "reasons": [],
   484	                    }
   485	                )
   486	    cell = copy.deepcopy(component.cell)
   487	    cell["floor"]["whole_window_drift_allowance_provenance"] = dict(
   488	        component.whole_window_drift_allowance
   489	    )
   490	    cell.update(
   491	        {
   492	            "cell_id": component.calibration_cell_id,
   493	            "kind": component.kind,
   494	            "metric": "phase_energy_j.decode",
   495	            "window_class": "phase",
   496	            "extractable": True,
   497	            "refusal_reasons": [],
   498	            "members": rows,
   499	            "whole_window_drift_allowance": dict(
   500	                component.whole_window_drift_allowance
   501	            ),
   502	        }
   503	    )
   504	    report = {
   505	        "schema_version": mint1.EXTRACTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   506	        "spec_schema_version": mint1.EXTRACTION_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   507	        "runs_root": str(root),
   508	        "consumption_semantics_id": component.consumption_semantics_id,
   509	        "spec_membership_refusals": [],
   510	        "idle_admission_refusals": [],
   511	        "cells": [cell],
   512	    }
   513	    report_path = base / f"{label}-report.json"
   514	    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
   515	    order = {
   516	        **component.order_manifest,
   517	        "executed_order": [
   518	            {"run_id": bundle_id}
   519	            for bundle_id in mint1._spec_member_ids(component.spec)
   520	        ],
   521	    }
   522	    order_path = base / f"{label}-order.json"
   523	    order_path.write_text(json.dumps(order), encoding="utf-8")
   524	    spec_ids = mint1._spec_member_ids(component.spec)
   525	    reference_count = component.evaluation_basis_member_count - len(spec_ids)
   526	    basis_ids = [
   527	        *spec_ids,
   528	        *(f"{label}-reference-{index}" for index in range(reference_count)),
   529	    ]
   530	    (root / "campaign_log.jsonl").write_text(
   531	        json.dumps(
   532	            {
   533	                "evaluation_basis": {
   534	                    "sha256": component.whole_window_evaluation_basis_sha256,
   535	                    "member_occurrences": [
   536	                        {"bundle_id": bundle_id} for bundle_id in basis_ids
   537	                    ],
   538	                }
   539	            }
   540	        )
   541	        + "\n",
   542	        encoding="utf-8",
   543	    )
   544	    return generalized.ComponentInputs(
   545	        evidence_root=root,
   546	        report_path=report_path,
   547	        spec_path=spec_path,
   548	        order_manifest_path=order_path,
   549	    )

   552	def _role_components(
   553	    absolute: mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   554	    comparative: mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   555	    *,
   556	    role: str,
   557	    family_id: str,
   558	    plan_id: str,
   559	    plan_sha256: str,
   560	) -> tuple[
   561	    mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   562	    mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   563	    dict,
   564	]:
   565	    metric = f"phase_energy_j.{role}"
   566	    source_binding = absolute.spec_cell["condition_family_definitions"]["all"]
   567	    definition = copy.deepcopy(source_binding["condition_family_definition"])
   568	    definition["condition_family_id"] = family_id
   569	    family_sha256 = canonical_domain_sha256(CONDITION_FAMILY_DOMAIN, definition)
   570	    binding = {
   571	        "condition_family_id": family_id,
   572	        "condition_family_definition": definition,
   573	        "condition_family_sha256": family_sha256,
   574	    }
   575	
   576	    def convert(
   577	        component: mint1.AuthenticatedComponent,
   578	    ) -> mint1.AuthenticatedComponent:
   579	        spec_cell = copy.deepcopy(component.spec_cell)
   580	        spec_cell["metric"] = metric
   581	        spec_cell["condition_family_id"] = family_id
   582	        spec_cell["condition_family_definitions"] = (
   583	            {"all": binding}
   584	            if component.kind == "absolute"
   585	            else {"A": binding, "B": binding}
   586	        )
   587	        order_manifest = {
   588	            **component.order_manifest,
   589	            "plan_id": plan_id,
   590	            "calibration_plan_sha256": plan_sha256,
   591	        }
   592	        return replace(
   593	            component,
   594	            spec_cell=spec_cell,
   595	            order_manifest=order_manifest,
   596	        )
   597	
   598	    return convert(absolute), convert(comparative), binding

   359	    if not isinstance(value, list) or not value:
   360	        raise MintError(f"{label} must be a nonempty array")
   361	    result = []
   362	    for index, item in enumerate(value):
   363	        row_label = f"{label}[{index}]"
   364	        row = _object(
   365	            item,
   366	            row_label,
   367	            {"condition_family_id", "condition_family_sha256"},
   368	        )
   369	        result.append(
   370	            (
   371	                _string(
   372	                    row["condition_family_id"],
   373	                    f"{row_label}.condition_family_id",
   374	                ),
   375	                _sha256(
   376	                    row["condition_family_sha256"],
   377	                    f"{row_label}.condition_family_sha256",
   378	                ),
   379	            )
   380	        )
   381	    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
   382	        raise MintError(f"{label} entries must be unique")
   383	    return tuple(result)

   386	def _parse_v2_component(value: object, label: str) -> ComponentPins:
   387	    row = _object(
   388	        value,
   389	        label,
   390	        {
   391	            "evidence_root_id",
   392	            "calibration_cell_id",
   393	            "evaluation_basis_sha256",
   394	            "evaluation_basis_members",
   395	            "extraction_spec_sha256",
   396	            "extraction_spec_members",
   397	            "expected_n",
   398	            "drift_allowance_j",
   399	            "order_manifest_id",
   400	            "order_manifest_sha256",
   401	            "members",
   402	        },
   403	    )
   404	    members = _member_pins(row["members"], f"{label}.members")
   405	    extraction_count = _positive_int(
   406	        row["extraction_spec_members"], f"{label}.extraction_spec_members"
   407	    )
   408	    # Parse the additional hashes even though the v1-compatible core consumes
   409	    # only the ComponentPins projection.  The v2 gate authenticates them
   410	    # against the supplied component evidence before construction.
   411	    _sha256(row["extraction_spec_sha256"], f"{label}.extraction_spec_sha256")
   412	    _sha256(row["order_manifest_sha256"], f"{label}.order_manifest_sha256")
   413	    return ComponentPins(
   414	        evidence_root_id=_evidence_root_id(
   415	            row["evidence_root_id"], f"{label}.evidence_root_id"
   416	        ),
   417	        calibration_cell_id=_string(
   418	            row["calibration_cell_id"], f"{label}.calibration_cell_id"
   419	        ),
   420	        evaluation_basis_sha256=_sha256(
   421	            row["evaluation_basis_sha256"],
   422	            f"{label}.evaluation_basis_sha256",
   423	        ),
   424	        evaluation_basis_members=_positive_int(
   425	            row["evaluation_basis_members"],
   426	            f"{label}.evaluation_basis_members",
   427	        ),
   428	        extraction_spec_members=extraction_count,
   429	        expected_n=_positive_int(row["expected_n"], f"{label}.expected_n"),
   430	        drift_allowance_j=_nonnegative_number(
   431	            row["drift_allowance_j"], f"{label}.drift_allowance_j"
   432	        ),
   433	        order_manifest_id=_string(
   434	            row["order_manifest_id"], f"{label}.order_manifest_id"
   435	        ),
   436	    )

   439	def _parse_v2_postcollection(value: object, label: str) -> None:
   440	    row = _object(
   441	        value,
   442	        label,
   443	        {
   444	            "absolute_evaluation_basis_sha256",
   445	            "absolute_evaluation_basis_members",
   446	            "comparative_evaluation_basis_sha256",
   447	            "comparative_evaluation_basis_members",
   448	            "pre_receipt_sha256",
   449	            "pre_content_sha256",
   450	            "post_receipt_sha256",
   451	            "post_content_sha256",
   452	            "bracket_binding_sha256",
   453	            "terminal_ledger_head_sha256",
   454	            "observed_drift_s",
   455	            "allowance_rule",
   456	            "bracket_screen_s",
   457	            "applied_allowance_s",
   458	            "allowance_embedding_count",
   459	            "extraction_report_sha256",
   460	            "absolute_floor_six_decimal",
   461	            "comparative_floor_six_decimal",
   462	            "operative_floor_six_decimal",
   463	        },
   464	    )
   465	    for name in (
   466	        "absolute_evaluation_basis_sha256",
   467	        "comparative_evaluation_basis_sha256",
   468	        "pre_receipt_sha256",
   469	        "pre_content_sha256",
   470	        "post_receipt_sha256",
   471	        "post_content_sha256",
   472	        "bracket_binding_sha256",
   473	        "terminal_ledger_head_sha256",
   474	        "extraction_report_sha256",
   475	    ):
   476	        _sha256(row[name], f"{label}.{name}")
   477	    _positive_int(
   478	        row["absolute_evaluation_basis_members"],
   479	        f"{label}.absolute_evaluation_basis_members",
   480	    )
   481	    _positive_int(
   482	        row["comparative_evaluation_basis_members"],
   483	        f"{label}.comparative_evaluation_basis_members",
   484	    )
   485	    if row["allowance_rule"] != V2_ALLOWANCE_RULE:
   486	        raise MintError(
   487	            f"{label}.allowance_rule must equal {V2_ALLOWANCE_RULE!r}"
   488	        )
   489	    if row["bracket_screen_s"] != V2_BRACKET_SCREEN_S:
   490	        raise MintError(
   491	            f"{label}.bracket_screen_s must equal {V2_BRACKET_SCREEN_S!r}"
   492	        )
   493	    if row["allowance_embedding_count"] != 1:
   494	        raise MintError(
   495	            f"{label}.allowance_embedding_count must equal 1 (once per cell)"
   496	        )
   497	    observed = _decimal_text(row["observed_drift_s"], f"{label}.observed_drift_s")
   498	    applied = _decimal_text(
   499	        row["applied_allowance_s"], f"{label}.applied_allowance_s"
   500	    )
   501	    if applied != max(observed, Decimal(V2_BRACKET_SCREEN_S)):
   502	        raise MintError(
   503	            f"{label}.applied_allowance_s does not apply the never-zero rule once"
   504	        )
   505	    absolute = Decimal(
   506	        _six_decimal(
   507	            row["absolute_floor_six_decimal"],
   508	            f"{label}.absolute_floor_six_decimal",
   509	        )
   510	    )
   511	    comparative = Decimal(
   512	        _six_decimal(
   513	            row["comparative_floor_six_decimal"],
   514	            f"{label}.comparative_floor_six_decimal",
   515	        )
   516	    )
   517	    operative = Decimal(
   518	        _six_decimal(
   519	            row["operative_floor_six_decimal"],
   520	            f"{label}.operative_floor_six_decimal",
   521	        )
   522	    )
   523	    if operative != max(absolute, comparative):
   524	        raise MintError(
   525	            f"{label}.operative_floor_six_decimal must equal the armwise maximum, never a sum"
   526	        )
   527

   529	def _parse_v2_pinset(value: object) -> V2Pinset:
   530	    root = _object(
   531	        value,
   532	        "pinset",
   533	        {"schema_version", "mint_tool_version", "producer_plans", "aggregate"},
   534	    )
   535	    if root["schema_version"] != PINSET_SCHEMA_VERSION_V2:
   536	        raise MintError(
   537	            f"pinset.schema_version must equal {PINSET_SCHEMA_VERSION_V2!r}"
   538	        )
   539	    if root["mint_tool_version"] != V2_MINT_TOOL_VERSION:
   540	        raise MintError(
   541	            f"pinset.mint_tool_version must equal {V2_MINT_TOOL_VERSION!r}"

   543	    producers = root["producer_plans"]
   544	    if not isinstance(producers, list) or len(producers) != 2:
   545	        raise MintError("pinset.producer_plans must contain exactly two plans")

   547	    plan_ids: list[str] = []
   548	    cell_ids: list[str] = []
   549	    group_ids: list[str] = []
   550	    for producer_index, producer_value in enumerate(producers):
   551	        label = f"pinset.producer_plans[{producer_index}]"
   552	        producer = _object(
   553	            producer_value,
   554	            label,
   555	            {
   556	                "plan",
   557	                "evidence_root_id",
   558	                "component_artifact",
   559	                "model_runtime_config",
   560	                "extraction_spec",
   561	                "calibration_acceptance",
   562	                "cells",

   572	                "sidecar_sha256",
   573	                "relative_path",
   574	                "declared_calibration_scope",
   575	                "artifact_calibration_scope",

   581	            _sha256(plan[name], f"{label}.plan.{name}")
   582	        _string(plan["relative_path"], f"{label}.plan.relative_path")
   583	        _string(
   584	            plan["declared_calibration_scope"],
   585	            f"{label}.plan.declared_calibration_scope",
   586	        )

   588	            raise MintError(
   589	                f"{label}.plan.artifact_calibration_scope must equal 'production_window'"

   592	            producer["evidence_root_id"], f"{label}.evidence_root_id"
   593	        )
   594	        component_artifact = _object(
   595	            producer["component_artifact"],
   596	            f"{label}.component_artifact",
   597	            {"artifact_id", "sha256"},
   598	        )
   599	        _string(
   600	            component_artifact["artifact_id"],
   601	            f"{label}.component_artifact.artifact_id",
   602	        )
   603	        _sha256(
   604	            component_artifact["sha256"],
   605	            f"{label}.component_artifact.sha256",
   606	        )
   607	        runtime = _object(
   608	            producer["model_runtime_config"],
   609	            f"{label}.model_runtime_config",
   610	            {
   611	                "model_artifact_sha256",
   612	                "runtime_identity_sha256",
   613	                "config_set_sha256",
   614	            },
   615	        )
   616	        for name in runtime:

   619	            producer["extraction_spec"],
   620	            f"{label}.extraction_spec",

   624	        _positive_int(
   625	            extraction["member_count"],
   626	            f"{label}.extraction_spec.member_count",
   627	        )
   628	        acceptance = _object(
   629	            producer["calibration_acceptance"],
   630	            f"{label}.calibration_acceptance",
   631	            {
   632	                "acceptance_id",
   633	                "artifact_sha256",
   634	                "derivation_sha256",
   635	                "derivation_rule_id",
   636	            },
   637	        )
   638	        _string(
   639	            acceptance["acceptance_id"],
   640	            f"{label}.calibration_acceptance.acceptance_id",
   641	        )
   642	        _sha256(
   643	            acceptance["artifact_sha256"],
   644	            f"{label}.calibration_acceptance.artifact_sha256",
   645	        )
   646	        _sha256(
   647	            acceptance["derivation_sha256"],
   648	            f"{label}.calibration_acceptance.derivation_sha256",
   649	        )
   650	        _string(
   651	            acceptance["derivation_rule_id"],
   652	            f"{label}.calibration_acceptance.derivation_rule_id",
   653	        )
   654	
   655	        cells = producer["cells"]

   657	            raise MintError(f"{label}.cells must contain decode and prefill")
   658	        roles = []

   676	                    "comparative",
   677	                    "postcollection",

   679	            )

   682	            expected_metric = {
   683	                "decode": "phase_energy_j.decode",
   684	                "prefill": "phase_energy_j.prefill",

   688	            if cell["metric"] != expected_metric:
   689	                raise MintError(

   692	            if cell["window_class"] != "phase":
   693	                raise MintError(f"{cell_label}.window_class must equal 'phase'")
   694	            if cell["target_precheck_path"] != ["phase", role]:
   695	                raise MintError(

   697	                )
   698	            cell_id = _string(cell["cell_id"], f"{cell_label}.cell_id")
   699	            group_id = _string(
   700	                cell["transport_group_id"],
   701	                f"{cell_label}.transport_group_id",
   702	            )
   703	            cell_ids.append(cell_id)
   704	            group_ids.append(group_id)
   705	            _string(
   706	                cell["condition_family_id"],
   707	                f"{cell_label}.condition_family_id",

   709	            _sha256(

   711	                f"{cell_label}.condition_family_sha256",

   718	            comparative = _parse_v2_component(

   735	                != absolute.evaluation_basis_members
   736	                or post["comparative_evaluation_basis_sha256"]
   737	                != comparative.evaluation_basis_sha256
   738	                or post["comparative_evaluation_basis_members"]
   739	                != comparative.evaluation_basis_members
   740	            ):
   741	                raise MintError(
   742	                    f"{cell_label}.postcollection evaluation basis disagrees with component pins"
   743	                )
   744	            component_member_universe.update(
   745	                bundle_id for bundle_id, _digest in _member_pins(
   746	                    cell["absolute"]["members"], f"{cell_label}.absolute.members"

   748	            )
   749	            component_member_universe.update(
   750	                bundle_id for bundle_id, _digest in _member_pins(
   751	                    cell["comparative"]["members"],
   752	                    f"{cell_label}.comparative.members",
   753	                )
   754	            )

   760	            )

   762	    if len(plan_ids) != len(set(plan_ids)):

   774	            "plan_set_id",
   775	            "producer_set_sha256",
   776	            "calibration_scope",
   777	            "source_class",
   778	            "cell_composition_rule",
   779	            "consumer_floor_rule",
   780	            "component_artifacts",
   781	            "cell_ids",
   782	            "transport_allowlists",

   790	    )

   792	        raise MintError("pinset.aggregate.calibration_scope must equal 'production_window'")
   793	    if aggregate["source_class"] != "prospective":
   794	        raise MintError("pinset.aggregate.source_class must equal 'prospective'")
   795	    if aggregate["cell_composition_rule"] != V2_CELL_COMPOSITION_RULE:

   812	            entry_label,

   852	            f"{entry_label}.allowed_consumer_condition_families",
   853	        )

   857	def _parse_pinset(value: object) -> MintPinset:
   858	    root = _object(
   859	        value,
   860	        "pinset",
  1390	                expected_kind="comparative",
  1391	            ),
  1392	            project_commit=project_commit,
  1393	            project_tree_state=project_tree_state,
  1394	            strict_validator=strict_validator,
  1395	            consumption_semantics_id=consumption_semantics_id,
  1396	        )
  1397	    except core.MintError as exc:

  1401	def _canonical_json_sha256(value: object) -> str:
  1402	    try:
  1403	        payload = json.dumps(
  1404	            value,
  1405	            sort_keys=True,
  1406	            separators=(",", ":"),
  1407	            ensure_ascii=False,
  1408	            allow_nan=False,
  1409	        ).encode("utf-8")
  1410	    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
  1411	        raise MintError("v2 pin projection is not canonical JSON") from exc
  1412	    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
  1413	
  1414	
  1415	def _artifact_payload(artifact: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
  1416	    return (
  1417	        json.dumps(artifact, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
  1418	    ).encode("utf-8")
  1419	
  1420	
  1421	def _artifact_sha256(artifact: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
  1422	    return hashlib.sha256(_artifact_payload(artifact)).hexdigest()

  1425	def _v2_producer_hashes(pinset: V2Pinset) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]:
  1426	    producers = pinset.value["producer_plans"]
  1427	    producer_hashes = tuple(_canonical_json_sha256(row) for row in producers)

  1432	def _validate_v2_pin_hashes(pinset: V2Pinset) -> None:
  1433	    producer_hashes, producer_set_hash = _v2_producer_hashes(pinset)
  1434	    aggregate = pinset.value["aggregate"]
  1435	    for index, (observed, entry) in enumerate(
  1436	        zip(producer_hashes, aggregate["component_artifacts"])
  1437	    ):
  1438	        if observed != entry["producer_pin_sha256"]:
  1439	            raise MintError(
  1440	                "aggregate/component hash mismatch: producer pin "
  1441	                f"{index} expected {entry['producer_pin_sha256']}, observed {observed}"
  1442	            )
  1443	    if producer_set_hash != aggregate["producer_set_sha256"]:
  1444	        raise MintError(
  1445	            "aggregate hash mismatch: producer_set_sha256 expected "
  1446	            f"{aggregate['producer_set_sha256']}, observed {producer_set_hash}"
  1447	        )

  1451	    return _parse_v2_component(component, label)

  1454	def _v2_mint_pinset(

  1479	            operative_floor_six_decimal=post["operative_floor_six_decimal"],
  1480	        ),
  1481	        absolute=_v2_component_pins(cell["absolute"], "v2.cell.absolute"),
  1482	        comparative=_v2_component_pins(
  1483	            cell["comparative"], "v2.cell.comparative"
  1484	        ),
  1485	    )

  1488	def _v2_gate_component(
  1489	    actual: Any,
  1490	    pins: Mapping[str, Any],
  1491	    *,
  1492	    label: str,
  1493	    metric: str,
  1494	    window_class: str,
  1495	) -> None:
  1496	    if actual.spec_sha256 != pins["extraction_spec_sha256"]:
  1497	        raise MintError(f"{label}: extraction spec sha256 mismatch")
  1498	    if actual.order_manifest_sha256 != pins["order_manifest_sha256"]:
  1499	        raise MintError(f"{label}: order manifest sha256 mismatch")
  1500	    if actual.spec_cell.get("metric") != metric or (
  1501	        actual.spec_cell.get("window_class") != window_class
  1502	    ):
  1503	        raise MintError(f"{label}: wrong metric/phase precheck component")
  1504	    observed_members = tuple(
  1505	        (member.bundle_id, member.config_sha256) for member in actual.members
  1506	    )
  1507	    expected_members = _member_pins(pins["members"], f"{label}.members")
  1508	    if observed_members != expected_members:
  1509	        raise MintError(f"{label}: exact member/config pins mismatch")
  1510

  1512	def _v2_allowed_families(
  1513	    supplied: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  1514	    pins: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  1515	    *,
  1516	    label: str,
  1517	) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
  1518	    expected = [
  1519	        (row["condition_family_id"], row["condition_family_sha256"])
  1520	        for row in pins
  1521	    ]
  1522	    observed = []
  1523	    normalized = []
  1524	    from joulewise.detection_floor import (
  1525	        CONDITION_FAMILY_DOMAIN,
  1526	        canonical_domain_sha256,
  1527	    )
  1528	
  1529	    for index, row in enumerate(supplied):
  1530	        if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
  1531	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] must be an object")
  1532	        definition = row.get("condition_family_definition")
  1533	        family_id = row.get("condition_family_id")
  1534	        family_sha256 = row.get("condition_family_sha256")
  1535	        if not isinstance(definition, Mapping) or not isinstance(family_id, str):
  1536	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] is incomplete")
  1537	        if canonical_domain_sha256(CONDITION_FAMILY_DOMAIN, definition) != (
  1538	            family_sha256
  1539	        ):
  1540	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] condition-family hash mismatch")
  1541	        observed.append((family_id, family_sha256))
  1542	        normalized.append(dict(row))
  1543	    if observed != expected:
  1544	        raise MintError(f"{label} does not match the transport allowlist pins")
  1545	    return normalized

  1548	def _build_v2_artifacts(
  1549	    *,
  1550	    pinset: V2Pinset,
  1551	    pinset_path: Path,
  1552	    pinset_sha256: str,
  1553	    producer_inputs: Mapping[str, V2ProducerInputs],
  1554	    project_commit: str,
  1555	    project_tree_state: str,
  1556	) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any], tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]]:
  1557	    """Build the combined artifact and its two deterministic components.
  1558	
  1559	    This helper deliberately does not compare the supplied producer/component
  1560	    hashes; it is the deterministic authoring primitive used to freeze those
  1561	    hashes.  The public mint entry point performs every comparison before it

  1568	        raise MintError("project_tree_state must be 'clean' or 'dirty'")

  1570	    all_cells: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []

  1572	    producer_plan_records: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []

  1576	        plan_id = plan_pins["plan_id"]
  1577	        inputs = producer_inputs.get(plan_id)

  1582	                f"producer inputs for {plan_id!r} must contain decode and prefill"
  1583	            )

  1585	            raise MintError(f"producer {plan_id!r}: calibration plan identity mismatch")
  1586	        producer_cells: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
  1587	        producer_groups: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
  1588	        for cell_index, cell_pins in enumerate(producer["cells"]):
  1589	            role = cell_pins["role"]
  1590	            cell_inputs = inputs.cells[role]
  1591	            _v2_gate_component(
  1592	                cell_inputs.absolute,
  1593	                cell_pins["absolute"],
  1594	                label=f"producer[{producer_index}].{role}.absolute",
  1595	                metric=cell_pins["metric"],
  1596	                window_class=cell_pins["window_class"],
  1597	            )

  1599	                cell_inputs.comparative,
  1600	                cell_pins["comparative"],
  1601	                label=f"producer[{producer_index}].{role}.comparative",
  1602	                metric=cell_pins["metric"],
  1603	                window_class=cell_pins["window_class"],
  1604	            )

  1606	            core = _configured_core(
  1607	                configured_pins,
  1608	                pinset_path=pinset_path,
  1609	                expected_pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  1610	            )
  1611	            try:
  1612	                cell_artifact = core.mint_authenticated_artifact(
  1613	                    artifact_id=producer["component_artifact"]["artifact_id"],
  1614	                    plan=inputs.plan,
  1615	                    plan_sha256=plan_pins["sha256"],
  1616	                    calibration_plan_relative_path=plan_pins["relative_path"],
  1617	                    absolute=cell_inputs.absolute,
  1618	                    comparative=cell_inputs.comparative,
  1619	                    project_commit=project_commit,
  1620	                    project_tree_state=project_tree_state,
  1621	                )
  1622	            except core.MintError as exc:
  1623	                raise MintError(str(exc)) from exc
  1624	            cell = copy.deepcopy(cell_artifact["cells"][0])
  1625	            group = copy.deepcopy(cell_artifact["transport_groups"][0])
  1626	            post = cell_pins["postcollection"]
  1627	            if format(cell["floor_abs_j"], ".6f") != (
  1628	                post["absolute_floor_six_decimal"]
  1629	            ):
  1630	                raise MintError("supplied absolute six-decimal literal mismatch")
  1631	            if format(cell["floor_cmp_j"], ".6f") != (
  1632	                post["comparative_floor_six_decimal"]
  1633	            ):

  1638	                label=f"producer[{producer_index}].cells[{cell_index}].allowlist",
  1639	            )

  1641	            producer_cells.append(cell)
  1642	            producer_groups.append(group)

  1644	        first_cell_artifact = cell_artifact
  1645	        component = {
  1646	            **copy.deepcopy(first_cell_artifact),
  1647	            "artifact_id": producer["component_artifact"]["artifact_id"],
  1648	            "cells": producer_cells,
  1649	            "transport_groups": producer_groups,
  1650	        }
  1651	        component_errors = validate_floor_artifact(
  1652	            artifact=component,
  1653	            pinset_path=pinset_path,
  1654	            pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  1655	            _skip_v2_hash_binding=True,
  1656	        )
  1657	        if component_errors:
  1658	            raise MintError(
  1659	                f"constructed v2 component artifact is invalid: {component_errors[0]}"
  1660	            )
  1661	        component_artifacts.append(component)
  1662	        all_cells.extend(copy.deepcopy(producer_cells))
  1663	        all_groups.extend(copy.deepcopy(producer_groups))
  1664	        producer_plan_records.append(
  1665	            {
  1666	                "plan_id": plan_id,
  1667	                "declared_calibration_scope": plan_pins[
  1668	                    "declared_calibration_scope"
  1669	                ],
  1670	                "relative_path": plan_pins["relative_path"],
  1671	                "sha256": plan_pins["sha256"],
  1672	            }
  1673	        )
  1674	
  1675	    aggregate = pinset.value["aggregate"]
  1676	    implementation = copy.deepcopy(
  1677	        component_artifacts[0]["provenance"]["implementation"]
  1678	    )
  1679	    artifact = {
  1680	        **copy.deepcopy(component_artifacts[0]),
  1681	        "artifact_id": aggregate["artifact_id"],
  1682	        "calibration_scope": aggregate["calibration_scope"],
  1683	        "source_class": aggregate["source_class"],
  1684	        "provenance": {
  1685	            "calibration_plan": {
  1686	                "plan_id": aggregate["plan_set_id"],
  1687	                "declared_calibration_scope": "production_window",
  1688	                "relative_path": Path(pinset_path).name,
  1689	                "sha256": aggregate["producer_set_sha256"],
  1690	            },
  1691	            "producer_calibration_plans": producer_plan_records,
  1692	            "mint_tool_version": V2_MINT_TOOL_VERSION,
  1693	            "implementation": implementation,
  1694	        },
  1695	        "cells": all_cells,
  1696	        "transport_groups": all_groups,
  1697	    }
  1698	    errors = validate_floor_artifact(
  1699	        artifact=artifact,
  1700	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  1701	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  1702	        _skip_v2_hash_binding=True,
  1703	    )
  1704	    if errors:
  1705	        raise MintError(f"constructed v2 aggregate artifact is invalid: {errors[0]}")
  1706	    return artifact, tuple(component_artifacts)

  1708	
  1709	def _validate_v2_artifact_binding(
  1710	    artifact: Mapping[str, Any],
  1711	    pinset: V2Pinset,
  1712	) -> list[str]:
  1713	    errors: list[str] = []
  1714	    value = pinset.value
  1715	    aggregate = value["aggregate"]
  1716	    try:
  1717	        _validate_v2_pin_hashes(pinset)
  1718	    except MintError as exc:
  1719	        errors.append(f"artifact.pinset: {exc}")
  1720	    if artifact.get("artifact_id") != aggregate["artifact_id"]:
  1721	        errors.append("artifact: aggregate artifact_id mismatch")
  1722	    provenance = artifact.get("provenance")
  1723	    expected_producer_plans = [
  1724	        {
  1725	            "plan_id": producer["plan"]["plan_id"],
  1726	            "declared_calibration_scope": producer["plan"][
  1727	                "declared_calibration_scope"
  1728	            ],
  1729	            "relative_path": producer["plan"]["relative_path"],
  1730	            "sha256": producer["plan"]["sha256"],
  1731	        }
  1732	        for producer in value["producer_plans"]
  1733	    ]
  1734	    if not isinstance(provenance, Mapping):
  1735	        errors.append("artifact.provenance: v2 aggregate provenance is missing")
  1736	    else:
  1737	        expected_aggregate_plan = {
  1738	            "plan_id": aggregate["plan_set_id"],
  1739	            "declared_calibration_scope": "production_window",
  1740	            "relative_path": Path("pinset.json").name,
  1741	            "sha256": aggregate["producer_set_sha256"],
  1742	        }
  1743	        aggregate_plan = provenance.get("calibration_plan")
  1744	        if not isinstance(aggregate_plan, Mapping) or any(
  1745	            aggregate_plan.get(field) != expected
  1746	            for field, expected in expected_aggregate_plan.items()
  1747	            if field != "relative_path"
  1748	        ):
  1749	            errors.append("artifact.provenance: aggregate plan-set pin mismatch")
  1750	        if provenance.get("producer_calibration_plans") != expected_producer_plans:
  1751	            errors.append("artifact.provenance: producer plan pins mismatch")
  1752	        if provenance.get("mint_tool_version") != V2_MINT_TOOL_VERSION:
  1753	            errors.append("artifact.provenance: v2 mint-tool identity mismatch")
  1754	    cells = artifact.get("cells")
  1755	    groups = artifact.get("transport_groups")
  1756	    if not isinstance(cells, list) or not isinstance(groups, list):
  1757	        return [*errors, "artifact: v2 cells/transport_groups are not arrays"]
  1758	    if [cell.get("cell_id") for cell in cells if isinstance(cell, Mapping)] != (
  1759	        aggregate["cell_ids"]
  1760	    ):
  1761	        errors.append("artifact: four-cell order does not match aggregate pins")
  1762	    group_by_id = {
  1763	        group.get("transport_group_id"): group
  1764	        for group in groups
  1765	        if isinstance(group, Mapping)
  1766	    }
  1767	    cell_by_id = {
  1768	        cell.get("cell_id"): cell
  1769	        for cell in cells
  1770	        if isinstance(cell, Mapping)
  1771	    }
  1772	
  1773	    def formatted(value: object) -> str | None:
  1774	        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float):
  1775	            return None
  1776	        if not math.isfinite(float(value)):
  1777	            return None
  1778	        return format(value, ".6f")
  1779	
  1780	    for producer in value["producer_plans"]:
  1781	        for cell_pin in producer["cells"]:
  1782	            cell = cell_by_id.get(cell_pin["cell_id"])
  1783	            if not isinstance(cell, Mapping):
  1784	                continue
  1785	            key = cell.get("key", {})
  1786	            for field in (
  1787	                "metric",
  1788	                "window_class",
  1789	                "condition_family_id",
  1790	                "condition_family_sha256",
  1791	            ):
  1792	                expected = (
  1793	                    cell_pin[field]
  1794	                    if field in cell_pin
  1795	                    else cell_pin.get(field)
  1796	                )
  1797	                if key.get(field) != expected:
  1798	                    errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: {field} pin mismatch")
  1799	            post = cell_pin["postcollection"]
  1800	            if formatted(cell.get("floor_abs_j")) != post[
  1801	                "absolute_floor_six_decimal"
  1802	            ]:
  1803	                errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: absolute literal mismatch")
  1804	            if formatted(cell.get("floor_cmp_j")) != post[
  1805	                "comparative_floor_six_decimal"
  1806	            ]:
  1807	                errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: comparative literal mismatch")
  1808	            if formatted(cell.get("floor_gate_j")) != post[
  1809	                "operative_floor_six_decimal"
  1810	            ]:
  1811	                errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: operative literal mismatch")
  1812	            cell_provenance = cell.get("provenance", {})
  1813	            roots = {
  1814	                row.get("evidence_root_id")
  1815	                for row in cell_provenance.values()
  1816	                if isinstance(row, Mapping)
  1817	            }
  1818	            if roots != {producer["evidence_root_id"]}:
  1819	                errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: evidence-root pin mismatch")
  1820	            group = group_by_id.get(cell_pin["transport_group_id"])
  1821	            if not isinstance(group, Mapping) or group.get("source_cell_ids") != [
  1822	                cell_pin["cell_id"]
  1823	            ]:
  1824	                errors.append(
  1825	                    f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: transport must remain independently stack-scoped"
  1826	                )
  1827	            elif [
  1828	                (row.get("condition_family_id"), row.get("condition_family_sha256"))
  1829	                for row in group.get("allowed_consumer_condition_families", [])
  1830	                if isinstance(row, Mapping)
  1831	            ] != [
  1832	                (row["condition_family_id"], row["condition_family_sha256"])
  1833	                for row in cell_pin["allowed_consumer_condition_families"]
  1834	            ]:
  1835	                errors.append(f"cells[{cell_pin['cell_id']}]: transport allowlist mismatch")
  1836	
  1837	    if isinstance(provenance, Mapping):
  1838	        for producer, component_pin in zip(
  1839	            value["producer_plans"], aggregate["component_artifacts"]
  1840	        ):
  1841	            producer_cell_ids = [cell["cell_id"] for cell in producer["cells"]]
  1842	            producer_group_ids = [
  1843	                cell["transport_group_id"] for cell in producer["cells"]
  1844	            ]
  1845	            component = copy.deepcopy(dict(artifact))
  1846	            component["artifact_id"] = component_pin["artifact_id"]
  1847	            component["provenance"] = {
  1848	                "calibration_plan": expected_producer_plans[
  1849	                    value["producer_plans"].index(producer)
  1850	                ],
  1851	                "mint_tool_version": V2_MINT_TOOL_VERSION,
  1852	                "implementation": copy.deepcopy(
  1853	                    provenance.get("implementation")
  1854	                ),
  1855	            }
  1856	            component["cells"] = [
  1857	                copy.deepcopy(cell_by_id[cell_id])
  1858	                for cell_id in producer_cell_ids
  1859	                if cell_id in cell_by_id
  1860	            ]
  1861	            component["transport_groups"] = [
  1862	                copy.deepcopy(group_by_id[group_id])
  1863	                for group_id in producer_group_ids
  1864	                if group_id in group_by_id
  1865	            ]
  1866	            if len(component["cells"]) != 2 or len(
  1867	                component["transport_groups"]
  1868	            ) != 2:
  1869	                continue
  1870	            observed_component_sha256 = _artifact_sha256(component)
  1871	            if observed_component_sha256 != component_pin["sha256"]:
  1872	                errors.append(
  1873	                    "artifact: component artifact hash mismatch for "
  1874	                    f"{component_pin['plan_id']!r}"
  1875	                )
  1876	    return errors
  1877

  1879	def mint_multi_cell_authenticated_artifact(
  1880	    *,
  1881	    pinset_path: Path,
  1882	    pinset_sha256: str,
  1883	    producer_inputs: Mapping[str, V2ProducerInputs],
  1884	    project_commit: str,
  1885	    project_tree_state: str,
  1886	) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  1887	    """Mint the D-117 two-plan/four-cell artifact from authenticated inputs."""
  1888	
  1889	    loaded = load_pinset(pinset_path, pinset_sha256)
  1890	    if not isinstance(loaded, V2Pinset):
  1891	        raise MintError("multi-cell mint requires a final v2 pinset")

  1893	    artifact, components = _build_v2_artifacts(
  1894	        pinset=loaded,
  1895	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  1896	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  1897	        producer_inputs=producer_inputs,
  1898	        project_commit=project_commit,
  1899	        project_tree_state=project_tree_state,
  1900	    )

  1902	        zip(components, loaded.value["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"])
  1903	    ):
  1904	        observed = _artifact_sha256(component)
  1905	        if observed != expected["sha256"]:
  1906	            raise MintError(
  1907	                "aggregate/component hash mismatch: component artifact "
  1908	                f"{index} expected {expected['sha256']}, observed {observed}"
  1909	            )
  1910	    errors = validate_floor_artifact(
  1911	        artifact=artifact,
  1912	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  1913	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  1914	    )
  1915	    if errors:
  1916	        raise MintError(f"constructed v2 artifact is invalid: {errors[0]}")
  1917	    return artifact

  1920	def _load_v2_input_manifest(path: Path) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  1921	    try:
  1922	        raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
  1923	    except OSError as exc:

  1986	def _authenticate_v2_inputs(
  1987	    *,
  1988	    pinset: V2Pinset,
  1989	    pinset_path: Path,
  1990	    pinset_sha256: str,
  1991	    input_manifest_path: Path,
  1992	    strict_validator: StrictValidator,
  1993	    consumption_semantics_id: str | None,

  1995	    Mapping[str, V2ProducerInputs],
  1996	    Mapping[str, Path],
  1997	    Any,
  1998	]:
  1999	    manifest = _load_v2_input_manifest(input_manifest_path)
  2000	    rows = manifest["producer_plans"]
  2001	    if len(rows) != len(pinset.value["producer_plans"]):
  2002	        raise MintError("v2 input manifest must contain every producer plan exactly once")
  2003	    by_plan_id: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
  2004	    for index, row_value in enumerate(rows):
  2005	        label = f"v2 input manifest.producer_plans[{index}]"
  2006	        row = _object(
  2007	            row_value,
  2008	            label,
  2009	            {"plan_id", "calibration_plan", "cells"},
  2010	        )
  2011	        plan_id = _string(row["plan_id"], f"{label}.plan_id")
  2012	        if plan_id in by_plan_id:
  2013	            raise MintError("v2 input manifest producer plan ids must be unique")
  2014	        by_plan_id[plan_id] = row
  2015	
  2016	    result: dict[str, V2ProducerInputs] = {}
  2017	    evidence_roots: dict[str, Path] = {}
  2018	    ledger_snapshot = None
  2019	    for producer_index, producer in enumerate(pinset.value["producer_plans"]):
  2020	        plan_id = producer["plan"]["plan_id"]
  2021	        manifest_row = by_plan_id.get(plan_id)
  2022	        if manifest_row is None:
  2023	            raise MintError(f"v2 input manifest is missing producer {plan_id!r}")
  2024	        plan_path = Path(
  2025	            _string(
  2026	                manifest_row["calibration_plan"],
  2027	                f"v2 input manifest producer {plan_id}.calibration_plan",
  2028	            )
  2029	        )
  2030	        try:
  2031	            plan_raw = plan_path.read_bytes()
  2032	            plan = json.loads(
  2033	                plan_raw.decode("utf-8"),
  2034	                object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,
  2035	                parse_constant=_reject_nonfinite_json,
  2036	            )
  2037	        except OSError as exc:
  2038	            raise MintError(
  2039	                f"producer {plan_id!r} calibration plan cannot be read: "
  2040	                f"{exc.strerror or type(exc).__name__}"
  2041	            ) from exc
  2042	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
  2043	            raise MintError(
  2044	                f"producer {plan_id!r} calibration plan is invalid JSON: {exc}"
  2045	            ) from exc
  2046	        if not isinstance(plan, Mapping):
  2047	            raise MintError(f"producer {plan_id!r} calibration plan must be an object")
  2048	        if hashlib.sha256(plan_raw).hexdigest() != producer["plan"]["sha256"]:
  2049	            raise MintError(f"producer {plan_id!r} calibration plan sha256 mismatch")
  2050	        cells = manifest_row["cells"]
  2051	        if not isinstance(cells, list) or len(cells) != 2:
  2052	            raise MintError(
  2053	                f"v2 input manifest producer {plan_id!r} must contain two cells"
  2054	            )
  2055	        cell_rows: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
  2056	        for cell_index, cell_value in enumerate(cells):
  2057	            cell_label = (
  2058	                f"v2 input manifest producer {plan_id}.cells[{cell_index}]"
  2059	            )
  2060	            cell_row = _object(
  2061	                cell_value,
  2062	                cell_label,
  2063	                {
  2064	                    "role",
  2065	                    "absolute",
  2066	                    "comparative",
  2067	                    "allowed_consumer_condition_families",
  2068	                },
  2069	            )
  2070	            role = _string(cell_row["role"], f"{cell_label}.role")
  2071	            if role in cell_rows:
  2072	                raise MintError(f"producer {plan_id!r} cell roles must be unique")
  2073	            cell_rows[role] = cell_row
  2074	        if set(cell_rows) != {"decode", "prefill"}:
  2075	            raise MintError(
  2076	                f"producer {plan_id!r} input cells must be decode and prefill"
  2077	            )
  2078	
  2079	        authenticated_cells: dict[str, V2CellComponents] = {}
  2080	        for cell_pins in producer["cells"]:
  2081	            role = cell_pins["role"]
  2082	            cell_row = cell_rows[role]
  2083	            configured = _v2_mint_pinset(producer, cell_pins)
  2084	            core = _configured_core(
  2085	                configured,
  2086	                pinset_path=pinset_path,
  2087	                expected_pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  2088	            )
  2089	            if ledger_snapshot is None:
  2090	                ledger_snapshot = _load_v2_ledger_snapshot(core)
  2091	            authenticated = []
  2092	            for component_name, expected_kind in (
  2093	                ("absolute", "absolute"),
  2094	                ("comparative", "comparative"),
  2095	            ):
  2096	                paths = _v2_component_input_paths(
  2097	                    cell_row[component_name],
  2098	                    f"producer {plan_id}.{role}.{component_name}",
  2099	                )
  2100	                root_id = cell_pins[component_name]["evidence_root_id"]
  2101	                existing_root = evidence_roots.get(root_id)
  2102	                if existing_root is not None and existing_root.resolve() != (
  2103	                    paths.evidence_root.resolve()
  2104	                ):
  2105	                    raise MintError(
  2106	                        f"evidence-root id {root_id!r} maps to multiple paths"
  2107	                    )
  2108	                evidence_roots[root_id] = paths.evidence_root
  2109	                try:
  2110	                    component = core._authenticate_component(
  2111	                        core.ComponentPaths(
  2112	                            evidence_root_id=root_id,
  2113	                            evidence_root=paths.evidence_root,
  2114	                            report_path=paths.report_path,
  2115	                            spec_path=paths.spec_path,
  2116	                            order_manifest_path=paths.order_manifest_path,
  2117	                            calibration_cell_id=cell_pins[component_name][
  2118	                                "calibration_cell_id"
  2119	                            ],
  2120	                            expected_kind=expected_kind,
  2121	                        ),
  2122	                        expected_cell_id=cell_pins[component_name][
  2123	                            "calibration_cell_id"
  2124	                        ],
  2125	                        expected_basis_sha256=cell_pins[component_name][
  2126	                            "evaluation_basis_sha256"
  2127	                        ],
  2128	                        strict_validator=strict_validator,
  2129	                        expected_consumption_semantics_id=consumption_semantics_id,
  2130	                        calibration_ledger_snapshot=ledger_snapshot,
  2131	                    )
  2132	                except core.MintError as exc:
  2133	                    raise MintError(str(exc)) from exc
  2134	                authenticated.append(component)
  2135	            families = cell_row["allowed_consumer_condition_families"]
  2136	            if not isinstance(families, list):
  2137	                raise MintError(
  2138	                    f"producer {plan_id}.{role} allowed families must be an array"
  2139	                )
  2140	            authenticated_cells[role] = V2CellComponents(
  2141	                absolute=authenticated[0],
  2142	                comparative=authenticated[1],
  2143	                allowed_consumer_condition_families=tuple(families),
  2144	            )
  2145	        result[plan_id] = V2ProducerInputs(plan=dict(plan), cells=authenticated_cells)
  2146	    return result, evidence_roots, ledger_snapshot

  2149	def mint_multi_cell_floor_artifact(
  2150	    *,
  2151	    pinset_path: Path,
  2152	    pinset_sha256: str,
  2153	    input_manifest_path: Path,
  2154	    floor_path: Path,
  2155	    statement_path: Path,
  2156	    project_commit: str,
  2157	    project_tree_state: str,
  2158	    strict_validator: StrictValidator,
  2159	    consumption_semantics_id: str | None = None,
  2160	) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  2161	    """Authenticate all v2 sources, mint once, rebind, and write exclusively."""
  2162	
  2163	    loaded = load_pinset(pinset_path, pinset_sha256)
  2164	    if not isinstance(loaded, V2Pinset):
  2165	        raise MintError("multi-cell floor mint requires a final v2 pinset")

  2168	        pinset=loaded,
  2169	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  2170	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  2171	        input_manifest_path=input_manifest_path,
  2172	        strict_validator=strict_validator,
  2173	        consumption_semantics_id=consumption_semantics_id,
  2174	    )
  2175	    artifact, components = _build_v2_artifacts(
  2176	        pinset=loaded,
  2177	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  2178	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  2179	        producer_inputs=inputs,
  2180	        project_commit=project_commit,
  2181	        project_tree_state=project_tree_state,
  2182	    )
  2183	    for producer, component, expected in zip(
  2184	        loaded.value["producer_plans"],
  2185	        components,
  2186	        loaded.value["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"],
  2187	    ):
  2188	        observed = _artifact_sha256(component)
  2189	        if observed != expected["sha256"]:
  2190	            raise MintError(
  2191	                "aggregate/component hash mismatch: component artifact "
  2192	                f"{expected['plan_id']!r} expected {expected['sha256']}, observed {observed}"
  2193	            )
  2194	        cells_by_id = {
  2195	            cell["cell_id"]: cell for cell in component["cells"]
  2196	        }
  2197	        groups_by_id = {
  2198	            group["transport_group_id"]: group
  2199	            for group in component["transport_groups"]
  2200	        }
  2201	        for cell_pins in producer["cells"]:
  2202	            configured = _v2_mint_pinset(producer, cell_pins)
  2203	            core = _configured_core(
  2204	                configured,
  2205	                pinset_path=pinset_path,
  2206	                expected_pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  2207	            )
  2208	            single_cell_component = copy.deepcopy(dict(component))
  2209	            single_cell_component["cells"] = [
  2210	                copy.deepcopy(cells_by_id[cell_pins["cell_id"]])
  2211	            ]
  2212	            single_cell_component["transport_groups"] = [
  2213	                copy.deepcopy(
  2214	                    groups_by_id[cell_pins["transport_group_id"]]
  2215	                )
  2216	            ]
  2217	            try:
  2218	                core.bind_floor_artifact_evidence(
  2219	                    single_cell_component,
  2220	                    floor_path,
  2221	                    evidence_roots,
  2222	                    strict_validator=strict_validator,
  2223	                    calibration_ledger_snapshot=ledger_snapshot,
  2224	                )
  2225	            except core.MintError as exc:
  2226	                raise MintError(str(exc)) from exc
  2227	    errors = validate_floor_artifact(
  2228	        artifact=artifact,
  2229	        pinset_path=pinset_path,
  2230	        pinset_sha256=pinset_sha256,
  2231	    )
  2232	    if errors:
  2233	        raise MintError(f"post-bind v2 artifact validation failed: {errors[0]}")
  2234	    output_core = _fresh_original_core()
  2235	    try:
  2236	        output_core.write_outputs_exclusive(artifact, floor_path, statement_path)
  2237	    except output_core.MintError as exc:
  2238	        raise MintError(str(exc)) from exc

   826	def freeze_synthetic_v2_pinset(
   827	    root: Path,
   828	) -> tuple[Path, str, dict[str, generalized.V2ProducerInputs]]:
   829	    pinset, inputs = synthetic_v2_fixture()
   830	    draft_path, draft_sha256 = write_pinset(root, pinset)
   831	    parsed = generalized.load_pinset(draft_path, draft_sha256)
   832	    assert isinstance(parsed, generalized.V2Pinset)
   833	    _artifact, components = generalized._build_v2_artifacts(
   834	        pinset=parsed,
   835	        pinset_path=draft_path,
   836	        pinset_sha256=draft_sha256,
   837	        producer_inputs=inputs,
   838	        project_commit="0" * 40,
   839	        project_tree_state="clean",
   840	    )
   841	    for producer, entry, component in zip(
   842	        pinset["producer_plans"],
   843	        pinset["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"],
   844	        components,
   845	    ):
   846	        digest = generalized._artifact_sha256(component)
   847	        producer["component_artifact"]["sha256"] = digest
   848	        entry["sha256"] = digest
   849	    producer_hashes = [
   850	        generalized._canonical_json_sha256(producer)
   851	        for producer in pinset["producer_plans"]
   852	    ]
   853	    for entry, digest in zip(
   854	        pinset["aggregate"]["component_artifacts"], producer_hashes
   855	    ):
   856	        entry["producer_pin_sha256"] = digest
   857	    pinset["aggregate"]["producer_set_sha256"] = (
   858	        generalized._canonical_json_sha256(pinset["producer_plans"])
   859	    )
   860	    path, digest = write_pinset(root, pinset)
   861	    return path, digest, inputs

  1401	def _canonical_json_sha256(value: object) -> str:
  1402	    try:
  1403	        payload = json.dumps(
  1404	            value,
  1405	            sort_keys=True,
  1406	            separators=(",", ":"),
  1407	            ensure_ascii=False,
  1408	            allow_nan=False,
  1409	        ).encode("utf-8")
  1410	    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
  1411	        raise MintError("v2 pin projection is not canonical JSON") from exc
  1412	    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

  1415	def _artifact_payload(artifact: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
  1416	    return (
  1417	        json.dumps(artifact, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
  1418	    ).encode("utf-8")

  1421	def _artifact_sha256(artifact: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:

  1488	def _v2_gate_component(
  1489	    actual: Any,
  1490	    pins: Mapping[str, Any],
  1491	    *,
  1492	    label: str,
  1493	    metric: str,
  1494	    window_class: str,
  1495	) -> None:
  1496	    if actual.spec_sha256 != pins["extraction_spec_sha256"]:
  1497	        raise MintError(f"{label}: extraction spec sha256 mismatch")
  1498	    if actual.order_manifest_sha256 != pins["order_manifest_sha256"]:
  1499	        raise MintError(f"{label}: order manifest sha256 mismatch")
  1500	    if actual.spec_cell.get("metric") != metric or (
  1501	        actual.spec_cell.get("window_class") != window_class
  1502	    ):
  1503	        raise MintError(f"{label}: wrong metric/phase precheck component")
  1504	    observed_members = tuple(
  1505	        (member.bundle_id, member.config_sha256) for member in actual.members
  1506	    )
  1507	    expected_members = _member_pins(pins["members"], f"{label}.members")
  1508	    if observed_members != expected_members:
  1509	        raise MintError(f"{label}: exact member/config pins mismatch")

  1512	def _v2_allowed_families(
  1513	    supplied: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  1514	    pins: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  1515	    *,
  1516	    label: str,
  1517	) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
  1518	    expected = [
  1519	        (row["condition_family_id"], row["condition_family_sha256"])
  1520	        for row in pins
  1521	    ]
  1522	    observed = []
  1523	    normalized = []
  1524	    from joulewise.detection_floor import (
  1525	        CONDITION_FAMILY_DOMAIN,
  1526	        canonical_domain_sha256,
  1527	    )
  1528	
  1529	    for index, row in enumerate(supplied):
  1530	        if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
  1531	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] must be an object")
  1532	        definition = row.get("condition_family_definition")
  1533	        family_id = row.get("condition_family_id")
  1534	        family_sha256 = row.get("condition_family_sha256")
  1535	        if not isinstance(definition, Mapping) or not isinstance(family_id, str):
  1536	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] is incomplete")
  1537	        if canonical_domain_sha256(CONDITION_FAMILY_DOMAIN, definition) != (
  1538	            family_sha256
  1539	        ):
  1540	            raise MintError(f"{label}[{index}] condition-family hash mismatch")
  1541	        observed.append((family_id, family_sha256))
  1542	        normalized.append(dict(row))
  1543	    if observed != expected:
  1544	        raise MintError(f"{label} does not match the transport allowlist pins")
  1545	    return normalized

+def _project_floor_mint_pinset_v2(
+    value: object,
+) -> _FloorMintPinsetProjection | None:
+    """Project identities/root literals from a closed final-stage v2 pinset.
+
+    The generalized mint owns the complete v2 semantic validation.  This
+    reader deliberately projects only the authentication facts needed by the
+    detection-floor validator, while remaining structurally disjoint from the
+    desk-stage requirements document.
+    """
+
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != {
+        "schema_version",
+        "mint_tool_version",
+        "producer_plans",
+        "aggregate",
+    }:
+        return None
+    if value.get("schema_version") != _FLOOR_MINT_PINSET_SCHEMA_VERSION_V2:
+        return None
+    mint_tool_version = value.get("mint_tool_version")
+    producers = value.get("producer_plans")
+    aggregate = value.get("aggregate")
+    if (
+        not _is_trimmed_string(mint_tool_version)
+        or not isinstance(producers, list)
+        or len(producers) < 2
+        or not isinstance(aggregate, Mapping)
+    ):
+        return None
+    if set(aggregate) != {
+        "artifact_id",
+        "plan_set_id",
+        "producer_set_sha256",
+        "calibration_scope",
+        "source_class",
+        "cell_composition_rule",
+        "consumer_floor_rule",
+        "component_artifacts",
+        "cell_ids",
+        "transport_allowlists",
+    }:
+        return None
+    if not _is_trimmed_string(aggregate.get("plan_set_id")) or not _is_hex(
+        aggregate.get("producer_set_sha256")
+    ):
+        return None
+    identities = {
+        (
+            mint_tool_version,
+            aggregate["plan_set_id"],
+            aggregate["producer_set_sha256"],
+        )
+    }
+    root_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for producer in producers:
+        if not isinstance(producer, Mapping) or set(producer) != {
+            "plan",
+            "evidence_root_id",
+            "component_artifact",
+            "model_runtime_config",
+            "extraction_spec",
+            "calibration_acceptance",
+            "cells",
+        }:
+            return None
+        plan = producer.get("plan")
+        cells = producer.get("cells")
+        root_id = producer.get("evidence_root_id")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(plan, Mapping)
+            or not _is_trimmed_string(plan.get("plan_id"))
+            or not _is_hex(plan.get("sha256"))
+            or not _is_trimmed_string(root_id)
+            or not isinstance(cells, list)
+            or not cells
+        ):
+            return None
+        identities.add((mint_tool_version, plan["plan_id"], plan["sha256"]))
+        root_ids.add(root_id)
+        for cell in cells:
+            if not isinstance(cell, Mapping):
+                return None
+            for component_name in ("absolute", "comparative"):
+                component = cell.get(component_name)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(component, Mapping)
+                    or component.get("evidence_root_id") != root_id
+                ):
+                    return None
+    return _FloorMintPinsetProjection(
+        family_identities=frozenset(identities),
+        evidence_root_ids=frozenset(root_ids),
+    )

Verdict: **BLOCK / do not merge.** The focused tests pass, but mutation probes found authentication bypasses and a validator crash. No repository files were modified.

## Findings

1. **P0 — Required v2 “authentication” pins are presence-only and can lie about the evidence.**  
   [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:465](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:465), [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1496](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1496)

   The parser syntax-checks receipt, ledger, extraction-report, plan-sidecar, model/runtime, and calibration-acceptance hashes, but `_v2_gate_component` authenticates only extraction spec, order manifest, metric/window, and member/config pins.

   Concrete reproduced scenario: changed the pinned extraction-report SHA from the actual `111…111` to `999…999`, plus unrelated pre-receipt and runtime hashes, recomputed the aggregate producer hashes, and minted successfully:

   ```text
   MINT_SUCCEEDED
   actual_report_sha= 111111...111
   pinned_report_sha= 999999...999
   pinned_pre_receipt_sha= 888888...888
   pinned_runtime_identity_sha= 777777...777
   validator_errors= []
   ```

   Thus “missing/unresolved pin refuses” is only a structural test. A present but false resolved pin is accepted.

2. **P1 — Aggregate transport allowlists are ignored after shape validation.**  
   [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:830](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:830), [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1635](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1635)

   The aggregate list is checked for group/cell IDs and field shape, but its allowed families are never compared with each cell’s pins. Construction uses only the cell-level list.

   Reproduced:

   ```text
   MINT_SUCCEEDED
   aggregate_pin= aggregate-only-family aaaaa...aaaaa
   emitted_group= synthetic-0-decode b0a5...84cf
   validator_errors= []
   ```

   A contradictory authenticated aggregate declaration therefore mints and validates.

3. **P1 — The shared validator’s v2 “closed schema” projection silently accepts nested extra fields.**  
   [joulewise/detection_floor.py:1599](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/joulewise/detection_floor.py:1599)

   `_project_floor_mint_pinset_v2` checks producer top-level keys but does not close nested plan/cell/component objects. A plan with `silently_ignored_extra: true` produced:

   ```text
   shared_validator_errors= []
   generalized_validator= MintError ... schema mismatch: extra=['silently_ignored_extra']
   ```

   Existing callers of `joulewise.detection_floor.validate_floor_artifact`, including claim ingestion, therefore disagree with the mint validator about whether a v2 pinset is valid.

4. **P1 — Malformed v2 provenance crashes the shared validator.**

## Findings

1. **P0 — Required v2 “authentication” pins are presence-only and can lie about the evidence.**  
   [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:465](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:465), [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1496](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1496)

   The parser syntax-checks receipt, ledger, extraction-report, plan-sidecar, model/runtime, and calibration-acceptance hashes, but `_v2_gate_component` authenticates only extraction spec, order manifest, metric/window, and member/config pins.

   Concrete reproduced scenario: changed the pinned extraction-report SHA from the actual `111…111` to `999…999`, plus unrelated pre-receipt and runtime hashes, recomputed the aggregate producer hashes, and minted successfully:

   ```text
   MINT_SUCCEEDED
   actual_report_sha= 111111...111
   pinned_report_sha= 999999...999
   pinned_pre_receipt_sha= 888888...888
   pinned_runtime_identity_sha= 777777...777
   validator_errors= []
   ```

   Thus “missing/unresolved pin refuses” is only a structural test. A present but false resolved pin is accepted.

2. **P1 — Aggregate transport allowlists are ignored after shape validation.**  
   [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:830](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:830), [scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1635](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/u3/scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py:1635)

   The aggregate list is checked for group/cell IDs and field shape, but its allowed families are never compared with each cell’s pins. Construction uses only the cell-level list.

   Reproduced:

   ```text
   MINT_SUCCEEDED
   aggregate_pin= aggregate-only-family aaaaa...aaaaa
   emitted_group= synthetic-0-decode b0a5...84cf
   validator_errors= []
   ```

   A contradictory authenticated aggregate declaration therefore mints and validates.
